title: Things Are Getting Volatile in Tech-Land
summary: Anyone who turned on their screens today could not help but notice the selloff in stocks, particularly those in the tech sector. As I type this, the S&P 500 (SPX) is about 1.6% lower, and the Nasdaq 100 (NDX) is more than 3% lower. The fact that NDX is more volatile than SPX is not a surprise; that is quite typical. But I was asked this morning whether tech has become even more volatile recently, especially in comparison to the broader market. The short answer is “yes,” but it’s important to look at some of the key measures and the potential reasons why.
